message.title: Correction to Q2 2026 report and presentation
message.body:
With reference to the announcement made earlier today, 31 August 2026 (NewsWeb
messageID 681223)

Bakkafrost has identified a classification error in the appendix to the Q2 2026
report and presentation (appendix page 32), where operating expenses for
Scotland and the Faroe Islands were incorrectly classified as depreciation and
amortisation.

The error has no effect on EBIT, EBITDA, reported regional or group results,
cash flow, balance sheet, guidance or any other key performance indicators.

Corrected versions of the Q2 2026 report and presentation are attached and have
also been made available on the company's website.
